rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Single-horned dark blue-black oxlike Si of Guo Pu’s Erya commentary; fierce beast, not rhinoceros.

visual_requirements.description: One dark blue-black oxlike beast with exactly one horn, one head two eyes four cloven-hoofed legs and one tail.
Fierce charging motion only, dust from hooves, no documented magic.
Yunmeng hunting-ground context, rough reeds and dark woodland.

aura: Fierce animal charge c02, single-horn ox silhouette c01/c03 and dark hide c03/c06; no magic.
artistic_choices: Centered horn position is editorial placement because claim documents number rather than location.
Hide is tough and textured, not worn armor; c06 describes later human use, not armor on living beast.
Close foreshortened charge supplies dominance without unsupported gigantic scale; no literal blood foam from rhinoceros passage preceding Si in c07.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Si (兕), the fierce single-horned oxlike beast of ancient Chinese texts, using Guo Pu's dark blue-black variant.
ANATOMY: ONE powerful OXLIKE animal with dark BLUE-BLACK hide, broad bovine muzzle, two soft rounded ears, one head two natural eyes FOUR cloven-hoofed legs and ONE tail. Exactly ONE thick tapered hard horn rises forward from the center of its forehead; no paired lateral horns. The two ears are soft rounded furred ears, never horn-shaped. Muscular shoulder and dense tough hide, clearly oxlike not rhinoceros, no plates or straps. [si-c01, si-c03, si-c04, si-c06]
MOMENT: CHARGE straight at the viewer with head lowered and single horn thrust toward camera, near hoof striking loose soil, flared nostrils, hard focused eyes, muscles compressed in fierce motion. [si-c02]
POWER: no documented magical power; only physical charging force and ordinary dirt scattering from hooves. No breath fire, magical wind, blood foam or aura.
SCALE & CAMERA: extremely low close camera at hoof level; face, ONE horn and shoulder fill the square, foreshortened ordinary large bovine scale, no tiny humans or unsupported mountainsize body.
LIGHT & WEATHER: single oblique warm sunset slit through dark reeds, strong rim across horn and tough blue-black hide, deep shadows and natural airborne dust.
SURFACE: rough dense hide, coarse bristled neck, worn horn keratin, mud on hooves, shredded reeds.
SETTING: rough ancient Yunmeng hunting-ground reedbed and dark woodland of Chu, out of focus behind the charging beast. [si-c05]
MOOD: dangerous fierce mythic animal confrontation, never placid cattle at pasture, cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: exactly ONE horn and TWO soft ears; no extra heads, eyes, legs or fingers; no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
